## Bug-Introducing Commits
BIC: 43e45eb94e1aa0d1c4dbd10e99df8e366f637261

## Reasoning

**(1) Investigation:** I traced the history of `core/java/android/text/TextUtils.java` with `git log --follow -p`, since the fix commit modifies a single line inside the `isRTLCharacter` method in that file. I looked for when this method (and specifically the line with the `0xFE70`/`0xFEFF` range check) was first introduced.

**(2) Specific change:** Commit `43e45eb94` ("-Adds RTL (Right-To-Left) support for all RTL languages...") introduced the entire `isRTLCharacter(char c)` method, including the line:
```java
(c >= 0xFE70 && c <= 0xFEFF)    ;
```
This is the exact line later corrected by the bug-fix commit `137ce13f7`, which narrows the upper bound to `0xFEFE` to exclude `0xFEFF` (the zero-width no-break space / BOM marker) from being treated as RTL.

**(3) Evidence:** `git log --follow -p` shows this line was added verbatim (with the same `0xFEFF` bound) in `43e45eb94`, and no other commit in the file's history touches this range check between that commit and the fix. The fix commit's diff exactly reverses the single character introduced by `43e45eb94` (`0xFEFF` → `0xFEFE`), confirming it as the sole origin of the bug. There is no ambiguity here — the line was never modified between introduction and the fix, so this is the bug-introducing commit with high confidence.
